title: The real Ballon d'Or top ten, three rules, one name left
sources: data/ballondor/rankings.json (ballondor.com year rankings, in this repo)
checked: 2026 Ballon d'Or top ten, 26 Oct 2026, London: Kane, Mbappé, Yamal, Rodri, Messi, Kvaratskhelia, Dembélé, Haaland, Olise, Fabián Ruiz (Bulinews and Yen agree; Radio X for Kane). Past winners: Messi 8 times, Rodri 2024, Dembélé 2025 (ballondor.com data, Wikipedia). Ages on 4 Nov 2026 from Wikipedia dates of birth: Fabián Ruiz 30, Mbappé 27, Haaland 26, Kvaratskhelia 25, Olise 24, Yamal 19. Yamal: Euro 2024 winner (Wikipedia final), goal v France in the semi at 16, youngest Euros scorer, Spain won 2-1 (NBC Sports, The Local/AFP); World Cup 2026 winner, Spain 1-0 Argentina after extra time, Torres 106' (NBC, AP); third Kopa Trophy in a row (beIN, Africa Soccer). Olise has no senior tournament win with France (Wikipedia). Rule three: a senior World Cup or Euros title. No 'you' anywhere.

lines.text: Harry Kane just won the Ballon d'Or. So who wins it next? We took the real top ten and let three rules decide.
Kane, Mbappé, Yamal, Rodri and Messi.
lines.say: Kane, Embapay, Yamal, Roddree and Messee.

lines.text: Then Kvaratskhelia, Dembélé, Haaland, Olise and Fabián Ruiz.
lines.say: Then Kvahratskelleeuh, Dembehlay, Hohland, Ohleesay and Fabbeean Rooeeth.

lines.text: Rule one. He can't have won it before. Kane, Dembélé, Rodri and Messi are gone. Four in one go.
lines.say: Rule one. He can't have won it before. Kane, Dembehlay, Roddree and Messee are gone. Four in one go.

lines.text: Rule two. He has to be under twenty-five.
lines.say: Rule two. He has to be under twenty five.

lines.text: Fabián Ruiz is thirty, Mbappé twenty-seven, Haaland twenty-six, Kvaratskhelia twenty-five. All out.
lines.say: Fabbeean Rooeeth is thirty, Embapay twenty seven, Hohland twenty six, Kvahratskelleeuh twenty five. All out.

lines.text: Two left. Michael Olise, and Lamine Yamal.
lines.say: Two left. Michael Ohleesay, and Lameen Yamal.

lines.text: Rule three. He must have won a World Cup or a Euros with his country. Olise never has. Out.
lines.say: Rule three. He must have won a World Cup or a Euros with his country. Ohleesay never has. Out.

scene.sub: A World Cup or a Euros · Olise is out

lines.text: Yamal has won both. At sixteen, he curled this in against France, on the way to the Euros title.
lines.say: Yamal has won both. At sixteen, he curled this in against France, on the way to the Euros title.

lines.text: Then this summer, Spain beat Argentina in the World Cup final. Ferran Torres, in extra time.
lines.say: Then this summer, Spain beat Argentina in the World Cup final. Ferran Torres, in extra time.

lines.text: A Euros, a World Cup, and a third Kopa Trophy in a row. Nobody had ever won three.
And third in the Ballon d'Or, behind Kane and Mbappé. Already.
lines.say: And third in the Ballon d'Or, behind Kane and Embapay. Already.

lines.text: So the rules say the next winner is Lamine Yamal. Would anyone bet against him?
lines.say: So the rules say the next winner is Lameen Yamal. Would anyone bet against him?
